description: This file defines the Node data structure and associated methods for representing and manipulating HTML document trees, including node types, navigation, insertion, removal, cloning, and stack operations.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents an element or content node in an HTML document tree, with properties for parent, children, siblings, type, data, namespace, and attributes.

methods.name: InsertBefore
methods.description: Inserts a new child node before an existing child node within the parent node.

methods.name: AppendChild
methods.description: Appends a new child node to the end of the parent node's children.

methods.name: RemoveChild
methods.description: Removes a specified child node from the parent node.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the node, duplicating type, data, attributes, but not parent or children.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top node from the nodeStack.

methods.name: top
methods.description: Returns the most recently pushed node without removing it.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Finds the index of a node within the stack.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an atom is present in the stack.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a node at a specified index in the stack.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific node from the stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top insertionMode from the stack.

methods.name: top
methods.description: Returns the top insertionMode without removing it.
